profile_text.body:
Google is a public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Mountain View, CA, whose primary AI-facing web presence centers on Gemini, described on the company's site as an AI assistant intended to help with writing, planning, and brainstorming. The company trades on public markets under the ticker GOOGL and reported revenue of $402,836,000,000 for the period ending 2025-12-31, per its 10-K filing.

Google's tracked AI product portfolio spans several categories. Gemini serves as its general large language model assistant, while Google AI Studio is positioned for model prototyping by developers. In healthcare, Google offers Med-PaLM and MedLM, described as medical LLMs for clinical reasoning that require a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement. Additional products include NotebookLM, a document-grounded research tool; Google Drive AI and Google Meet AI, both integrated with Google Workspace; and TensorFlow and Keras, open-source machine learning frameworks that include TensorFlow Extended for MLOps workflows.

The held facts record no litigation associated with Google in the site's database. Google-connected services appear across ten third-party MCP servers in the registry, covering Google Ads campaign management and automation, Google Calendar scheduling, Google Forms, Google Search Console, Google News, and Google Trends, reflecting broad third-party integration activity around Google's platform APIs.
